info.title: Shields.io Universal API
info.description: Generate static, dynamic, and endpoint-backed badges through the public Shields.io badge image service.

get.description: Retrieves a badge image from JSON data in Shields.io.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: URL to a JSON document.

schema.description: URL to a JSON document.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: JSONPath expression used to select the badge value.

schema.description: JSONPath expression used to select the badge value.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: Badge style. Supported values include flat, flat-square, plastic, for-the-badge, and social.

schema.description: Badge style. Supported values include flat, flat-square, plastic, for-the-badge, and social.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

data.description: Raw SVG image bytes returned by Shields.io.

type.description: Raw response object type, usually Buffer for badge image data.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
